nodes.label: IParser · createParser
nodes.desc: IParser::parseFromFile walks a serialized ONNX protobuf and appends equivalent layers to an INetworkDefinition; createParser() binds it to a network and logger.

nodes.label: IBuilder · INetworkDefinition
nodes.desc: The build-side surface: INetworkDefinition declares layers, IBuilderConfig holds precision/tactic knobs, and IBuilder::buildSerializedNetwork compiles the plan.

nodes.label: VImpl ABI bridges
nodes.desc: VImpl classes that forward every public handle (buildSerializedNetwork, enqueueV3, serialize) into libnvinfer internals via mImpl.

nodes.label: IRuntime · ICudaEngine
nodes.desc: createInferRuntime returns IRuntime; deserializeCudaEngine turns the plan into ICudaEngine; createExecutionContext + enqueueV3 run inference on a CUDA stream.

nodes.label: IPluginV3 contract
nodes.desc: The versioned plugin interface: getCapabilities dispatches to core, build and runtime capability objects.

nodes.label: IPluginRegistry
nodes.desc: Global creator registry: registerCreator stores IPluginCreatorInterface instances keyed by name and namespace.

nodes.label: initLibNvInferPlugins
nodes.desc: Boots every bundled plugin creator into the registry under one library namespace via initializePlugin<C>() calls.

nodes.label: SkipLayerNormPluginV3
nodes.desc: A real IPluginV3 implementation (fused Skip-LayerNorm) whose creator self-registers with REGISTER_TENSORRT_PLUGIN.

nodes.label: nvinfer_plugin.map
nodes.desc: Linker script pinning the plugin library's exported C ABI, including initLibNvInferPlugins.
